The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has declared the UPSC CDS (II) 2025 Final Result on 30 March 2026. A total of 302 candidates have qualified based on the written examination conducted in September 2025 and SSB interviews held by the Services Selection Board, Ministry of Defence. The qualified candidates are eligible for admission to Indian Military Academy (IMA) Dehradun, Indian Naval Academy (INA) Ezhimala, and Air Force Academy (AFA) Hyderabad. Samar Islam Laskar has topped the IMA merit list.

Note: Some candidates are common across two or three academy lists. Medical examination results have not been taken into account. Verification of date of birth and educational qualifications is still under process by Army Headquarters.

How to Check UPSC CDS 2 Result 2025

  1. Visit the official UPSC website: upsc.gov.in
  2. Click on “Final Results” section
  3. Find the link for “Combined Defence Services Examination (II), 2025 – Final Result”
  4. Download the PDF and search for your Roll Number in the respective academy list (IMA / INA / AFA)
  5. Candidates marks will be available after declaration of final result of OTA Course for CDS (II) 2025

For queries, candidates may contact UPSC Facilitation Counter near Gate ‘C’ on telephone Nos. 011-23385271 / 011-23381125 / 011-23098543 between 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM on working days.
